source_direction.text: Wide underwater-readable pool view continuing from the joined fronts. Clarity expands through the entire giant water volume; natural aqua depth returns, the room brightens from dingy to pearl/aqua/lavender, and a localized violet glow begins deep below center. One slow push toward the glow. End with clean water and the violet light clearly rising but no person visible yet. No Rumi silhouette redesign, empty basin, or neon screen wash. Sound: temporary deep magical resonance and clear water ambience; no voices.
